title: MOASYS-Vault — shared Plex definitions
description: Definitions shared by the Plex pull outputs under output/plex/. Not a file shape on its own.

Library.description: One Plex library (section) and how it maps to this machine's configured roots.

plex_type.description: Plex section type: movie, show, artist, or photo.

slug.description: Folder name under output/plex/ — the title lowercased with unsafe characters replaced, plus the key on collision.

locations.description: Library folders as the server sees them.

mapped_locations.description: Each library folder that maps to a configured root. Unmapped folders are omitted.

library_path.description: Path relative to that root, forward slashes. Empty when the folder is the root itself.

media_type.description: The media type the library's folders map to; null when none map. Follows the folder, not the Plex library type — a Music library holding audiobooks is audiobooks.

item_count.description: Items in the last pull of this library.
